tools.name: list_websites
tools.description:
List the websites in the user's SEOPro AI account.

    Returns each website's numeric website_id (needed by most other tools),
    URL, platform and autopilot status. Call this first.

tools.name: get_website_stats
tools.description:
Get content stats for a website: total articles, keywords tracked,
    published posts and whether SEO autopilot is enabled.

tools.name: get_search_performance
tools.description:
Get the Google Search Console performance summary for a website:
    clicks, impressions, CTR, average position, top keywords, AI-assistant
    traffic sources and device/country breakdowns.

    Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_top_search_keywords
tools.description:
List the website's top search keywords with clicks, impressions, CTR
    and average position. Great for finding quick wins (positions 5-15 with
    high impressions). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_search_trends
tools.description:
Get monthly search-performance trends (clicks, impressions, CTR,
    average position) for the last N months. Use to spot growth or decay.

tools.name: get_ai_search_traffic
tools.description:
Show traffic the website receives from AI assistants and AI search
    (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, etc.): sessions, engaged pages and
    per-source breakdowns. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the last 30 days.

tools.name: run_seo_audit
tools.description:
Run a technical SEO audit on any URL: meta tags, headings, images,
    links, performance, content quality, security and social metadata, with
    a scored result. Rate-limited for free accounts.

tools.name: check_ai_citations
tools.description:
Check whether AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity)
    mention or cite a website when answering questions in its niche.
    Takes 1-3 minutes; results are cached for 7 days.

tools.name: get_backlink_profile
tools.description:
Get the website's backlink profile from the SEOPro AI backlink
    network: totals, unique sources, available credits and the most recent
    earned backlinks.

tools.name: get_keyword_plan
tools.description:
Get the website's scheduled keyword/content plan: which keywords are
    planned, their scheduled dates and statuses.

tools.name: generate_keyword_plan
tools.description:
Generate an AI keyword/content plan for the website. Optionally guide
    it with topic instructions and comma-separated primary/secondary
    keywords. Can take a minute or two. Set replace_existing=true only after
    the user explicitly approves discarding the current plan's pending topics;

tools.name: generate_article
tools.description:
Start generating an SEO article for a target keyword. Returns
    immediately; generation takes 5-10 minutes in the background — poll
    get_article_status for the scheduled_date until it shows a blog.

    scheduled_date is YYYY-MM-DD and defaults to today (UTC). One article is
    generated per w

tools.name: get_article_status
tools.description:
Check article generation/publication status per date. Dates are
    YYYY-MM-DD and default to the current month. A date with has_blog=true
    and a blog_id means the article is ready to read via get_article.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description:
List the website's articles (drafts and published), newest first.
    Optionally filter by status (e.g. 'draft', 'published').

tools.name: get_article
tools.description:
Read a single article by blog_id. By default returns metadata and a
    short excerpt; set include_content=true for the full HTML content.

tools.name: publish_article
tools.description:
Publish an article to the website's connected platform (WordPress,
    Shopify, Webflow, etc.). Set publish_as_draft=true to push it as an
    unpublished draft in the CMS instead of going live. Before calling, show
    the user the article and destination and obtain explicit approval. Every
    cal

tools.name: request_indexing
tools.description:
Submit up to 50 URLs for search-engine indexing (Google/Bing) via
    SEOPro AI auto-indexing. Requires the auto-indexing feature on the
    account. Show the exact URL list and obtain explicit user approval first;
    every call requires confirm_indexing=true.

tools.name: get_indexing_status
tools.description:
Get auto-indexing stats for the website: how many URLs are indexed,
    pending or failed.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "publish_article" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Publish an article to the website's connected platform (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, etc.). Set publish_as_draft=true to push it as an unpublished draft in the …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_websites, get_website_stats, get_article, request_indexing, get_indexing_status · Public sink: publish_article, request_indexing · Destructive: run_seo_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_websites, get_website_stats, get_article, request_indexing, get_indexing_status · Public sink: publish_article, request_indexing · Destructive: run_seo_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
